goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Energieerhaltung mit der tatsächlichen Systemgrenze verbinden; Wärme und Arbeit sind Übertragungsgrößen, innere Energie ist eine Zustandsgröße.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Connect conservation to the actual system boundary; heat and work are transfers, internal energy is a state quantity.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: Offenes, geschlossenes und isoliertes System unterscheiden und die Energieflüsse mit konsistenten Vorzeichen erklären.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Distinguish open, closed and isolated systems and explain energy transfers with consistent signs.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Beim offenen Gefäß den Energieinhalt austretender Materie ergänzen; starres Gefäß und Kolbenprozess unter ihren jeweiligen Bedingungen vergleichen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Include energy carried by escaping matter in an open vessel; compare rigid and piston processes under their respective conditions.
goals.atomicity: One coherent conservation and system-boundary competence. System classifications are conditions of its application, not separate unrelated routines.
goals.caseFindings: Both complete DE/EN cases and four-point rubrics are sound: 1200-350=850 J; 100 kPa times 2 L gives 200 J expansion work, 300 J internal-energy increase and, under the stated constant-pressure/only-pV assumptions, 500 J enthalpy change. The open-control-volume limitation and constant total U with changing temperature in an isolated reacting system are explicit. Formula provision supports the qualitative goal rather than claiming an additional quantitative source clearance.
goals.memoryReason: The first-law conservation statement and distinction between internal energy and transfer quantities are a compact, foundational recall item; card chem_energy_q4_001 is narrowly linked to this goal. Explanation and transfer remain in ordinary learning.
goals.imageFindings: Personally inspected native page 03, exact full PNG and own 360/680 frames. Q/W arrows use the stated positive-in convention; isolated-system arrows are blocked and U is constant. Image is orientation, not exhaustive open-system coverage. Main relation is legible at 360; small annotations are not claimed universally legible. Full goal ID and checked external prerequisite context fit the native page.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Reaktionsenthalpie als Zustandsgrößenänderung aus Hess-Bilanzen und begrenzten kalorimetrischen Messungen bestimmen.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Determine reaction enthalpy as a state change using Hess balances and bounded calorimetric measurements.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: Teilreaktionen korrekt umkehren und addieren sowie Wärmebilanz, Stoffmenge, Phasen und Messgrenzen konsistent auswerten.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Reverse and add reaction steps correctly and consistently evaluate heat balance, amount, phases and measurement limits.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Hydratstufe, gasförmige Produkte oder Produktwasserphase verändern und deren Wirkung auf die Bilanz begründen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Change hydration state, gaseous products or product-water phase and explain their effect on the balance.
goals.atomicity: Hess calculation and simple calorimetry are complementary methods of one assessable reaction-enthalpy determination competence; the method conjunction alone does not require a split.
goals.caseFindings: All five complete DE/EN cases, data and rubrics inspected. Hess gives -110.5 kJ/mol and -55.25 kJ for 0.5 mol. Salt masses/calorimeter capacity give approximately -66.14 and +19.68 kJ/mol. ST Mg/HCl and ammonium-hydrogencarbonate/HCl equations balance; approximately -456.55/+38.13 kJ/mol follow the supplied synthetic data. Neutralization gives 224.64 J/-56.16 kJ/mol; net water and hydronium notation are distinguished. Gas-phase methane formation/bond calculations give -802.3/-802 kJ/mol. Phases, reaction extent, heat losses and exported gas energy are bounded. Where the source says plan/conduct, actual supervised execution, raw T(t), controls and repeats remain required; synthetic examples do not discharge it. Göttingen methods were inspected directly; the smaller quantities and fixed-mixture neutralization are explicitly author adaptations, not exact reproductions of donor measurements.
goals.memoryReason: Hess path independence and adding/reversing enthalpy steps form one compact necessary recall rule, covered by chem_energy_q4_002. Calorimetric reasoning is not reduced to memorization.
goals.imageFindings: Native page 04, full PNG and own 360/680 frames inspected. Hess arrows are a route sketch without an energy axis; intermediate height is not a quantitative energy assertion. q=mcΔT and approximate -q/n are appropriately an orientation approximation; full cases add calorimeter heat capacity/error limits. Page fits and exact ID/prerequisite and successor links remain present.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Temperaturabhängige Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit mit wirksamen Stößen erklären und die RGT-Regel als begrenzte Faustregel anwenden.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Explain temperature-dependent rates through effective collisions and apply RGT as a bounded rule of thumb.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: Ratenfaktoren aus Daten ermitteln, energetische und räumliche Stoßbedingungen erklären und einen Mechanismuswechsel erkennen.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Determine rate factors from data, explain energy/orientation collision conditions and identify a mechanism change.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Ausfall eines Katalysators und gasvolumetrische Messbedingungen gegen eine bloße Temperaturfaktor-Extrapolation prüfen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Check catalyst failure and gas-volume measurement conditions against simple temperature-factor extrapolation.
goals.atomicity: One temperature-rate explanation/application competence; collision theory supplies its mechanism.
goals.caseFindings: Three complete DE/EN cases inspected: factors 2.5/6.25; unchanged-mechanism prediction 0.1352 versus observed 0.012 demonstrates a failed assumption; supplied Mg/HCl early slopes 0.2/0.4/0.8 mL/s give 2x/4x. Gas temperature/pressure, oxide/surface, self-heating, controls, actual raw runs and repeats are required for the experiment. The NI whole temperature/pressure/concentration/catalyst operator was read separately; this temperature component does not clear its other factors or technique/research partners.
goals.memoryReason: The approximate 10 K / two-to-four factor and its rule-of-thumb limitation are compact necessary recall, accurately stated in chem_energy_q4_004.
goals.imageFindings: Native page 05, corrected full PNG and own frames inspected. Both panels contain five A and five B particles; temperatures differ by 10 K, movement/effective-collision indications change and the activation threshold is not claimed to change. Caption's often two-to-three example is bounded and is compatible with the wider ordinary RGT range. No universal exact factor claim.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: System- und Umgebungsentropie gemeinsam betrachten und mit der freien Enthalpie thermodynamische Richtung von Geschwindigkeit unterscheiden.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Consider system and surroundings entropy together and use Gibbs energy to distinguish thermodynamic direction from speed.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: Entropiebeiträge einschließlich endothermer Gegenfälle begründen und unter angegebenen T,p-Bedingungen mit ΔG prüfen.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Explain entropy contributions including endothermic contrasts and check them using ΔG under stated T,p conditions.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Lokale Entropieabnahme, statistische Modellgrenzen und tatsächlichen endothermen Lösungsvorgang voneinander abgrenzen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish local entropy decrease, statistical model limits and an actual endothermic dissolution.
goals.atomicity: The entropy/free-energy combination is one thermodynamic driving-force judgment. No goal-text split or rewrite is required by this image hold.
goals.caseFindings: All three complete DE/EN cases inspected. Freezing model: total entropy +1.08/-1.31 J/K and Gibbs -280/+380 J at 260/290 K. Four-particle box model has 1/4/6/4/1 multiplicities, 6/16=0.375 and kB ln6 about 2.474e-23 J/K; not a molar reaction entropy. Endothermic model gives surroundings -67.13, total +12.87 J/(mol K) and -3772 J/mol at 293.15 K. Real dissolution execution/controls/raw data remain necessary and no entropy measurement is claimed. German 'offenes isoliertes Gefäß' is interpretable as thermal insulation from apparatus/English context; 'wärmegedämmt' would be clearer but is not a separate science blocker.
goals.memoryReason: The competence is explanation of complete entropy balances and transfer, with model/constants supplied in tasks. No additional standalone entropy deck or rote recall requirement is justified by these cases.
goals.imageFindings: Exact original native page 06/full JPEG/own 360/680 frames inspected, without successor or peer verdicts. Original caption labels a spontaneous process as generic 'Energie wird frei'; no free-energy qualifier or fixed T,p model condition accompanies it, inviting the false exothermic/spontaneous equivalence that the actual endothermic cases explicitly test. The entropy illustration changes four same particles into six plus two different symbols while changing volume and ordering, with no declared model assumptions: it cannot isolate configurational entropy through visible disorder. Retain goal and P body; correct/qualify the image and obtain fresh bindings before current-page acceptance.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Freie Reaktionsenthalpie mit konsistenten Einheiten, Zuständen und Zusammensetzung berechnen und thermodynamische Richtung/Gleichgewicht von Kinetik trennen.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Calculate reaction Gibbs energy with consistent units, states and composition, separating thermodynamic direction/equilibrium from kinetics.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: ΔH−TΔS, Standardbildungsgrößen und redoxbezogene Arbeitsbilanz auswerten; ΔG° nicht mit tatsächlichem ΔG gleichsetzen.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Evaluate ΔH−TΔS, standard formation values and a redox work balance; do not identify ΔG° with actual ΔG.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Temperatur, Reaktionsquotient, Phase und Reaktionsfortschritt variieren und die Gültigkeitsbedingungen der Vorhersage benennen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Vary temperature, reaction quotient, phase and reaction extent and state prediction conditions.
goals.atomicity: Calculation plus interpretation of direction/equilibrium is a single quantitative Gibbs competence, rather than independent unrelated routines.
goals.caseFindings: All four complete DE/EN cases inspected: carbonate model +130.4114/-14.54 kJ/mol and about 1109.52 K; A/B model K about 5.67 and actual Gibbs +7.11 kJ/mol at Q=100; methane formation Gibbs -817.8 kJ/mol and -204.45 kJ for extent 0.25 mol; reversible redox -212.267 kJ/mol, work 2122.67 versus loaded 1640.245 J and dissipation 482.425 J. Formula, standard/current composition, kinetics and irreversible-work qualifications are sound. These are synthetic calculations, not experimental derivation. Accordingly the fifth NW source addition remains held even though the canonical computational profile is sufficient.
goals.memoryReason: ΔG=ΔH−TΔS and the condition-qualified negative-sign meaning are a compact necessary recall item, accurately represented by chem_energy_q4_003. Interpretation and Q dependence remain ordinary reasoning.
goals.imageFindings: Native page 07/full JPEG/own frames inspected. Worked -40−298(-0.100)=-10.2 kJ/mol and threshold 400 K are correct. ΔG is shown without a standard-state superscript; the zero criterion is read as actual reaction Gibbs at the considered states, not a claim that ΔG°=0 at arbitrary composition. Full profile explicitly supplies the necessary standard/composition and constant-H/S model limits. Text and formula remain unclipped.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Statistische Energieverteilung über normierte Flächen und eine Aktivierungsgrenze interpretieren.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Interpret a statistical energy distribution through normalized areas and an activation threshold.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: Kurvenmaximum, Breite und Anteil oberhalb der Grenze bei veränderter Temperatur richtig vergleichen.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Correctly compare curve peak, width and above-threshold fraction after a temperature change.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Eine abgesenkte katalytische Grenze bei unveränderter Verteilung von Erwärmung unterscheiden und Zusatzbedingungen einer Rate benennen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish a lower catalytic threshold with unchanged distribution from heating and identify additional rate conditions.
goals.atomicity: One distribution interpretation competence. The concise descriptor is made assessable by the complete bound plots/CSV and transfer profile, not by changing its scope.
goals.caseFindings: Both whole bilingual cases, all four actual DE/EN plot PNGs and the bound normalized-data/model formula inspected. Epeak=RT/2 gives 1.2471/1.8707 kJ/mol. Tasks distinguish area from height and include orientation/concentration/mechanism limits. The decorative primary sketch is not used as a numerical particle histogram or CSV substitute.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die zweite-Hauptsatz-Grenze zyklischer Wärmekraftmaschinen von Energieerhaltung und einmaliger Zustandsänderung unterscheiden.
goals.essentialUnderstandingEn: Distinguish the second-law limit for cyclic heat engines from energy conservation and a one-time state change.
goals.observablePerformanceDe: Zykluswärme, Arbeit und Abwärme bilanzieren und Energieverlust als verminderte Nutzbarkeit erklären.
goals.observablePerformanceEn: Balance cycle heat, work and rejected heat and explain energy loss as reduced usefulness.
goals.transferExpectationDe: Einmalige reversible Expansion und erforderliche Rücksetzung sowie den Arbeitsbedarf eines Kühlschranks vergleichen.
goals.transferExpectationEn: Compare a one-time reversible expansion and required reset, and a refrigerator's work requirement.
goals.atomicity: Everyday terminology is interpretation of the same cyclic heat-work limit, not an extra independent goal.
goals.caseFindings: Both whole bilingual cases inspected: 700 J rejected heat, reservoir entropy +0.333 J/K; single-reservoir claim would have -2 J/K. Reversible expansion yields about 1728.85 J and 5.763 J/K; changed gas state prevents calling it a cycle and reset cancels net work. Kelvin-Planck is correctly restricted to a full cycle and no energy destruction is inferred.
goals.memoryReason: The required reasoning concerns complete system/cycle conditions and explanatory transfer; no additional rote formula card is necessary.
goals.imageFindings: Native page 09/corrected full PNG/own frames inspected. Cycle is explicit, warm and cold reservoirs have correctly directed arrows; Qin=W+Qout, no 100% in a cycle and conserved energy are coherent. No blanket prohibition of a one-time heat-to-work conversion.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Entropieänderungen aus zugänglichen Energie- und Teilchenverteilungen begründet abschätzen, ohne sichtbare Unordnung mit Gesamtspontanität gleichzusetzen.

goals.essentialUnderstandingDe: Endergone und exergone Schritte durch einen gemeinsamen chemischen Weg koppeln und die vollständige freie-Energie-/Entropiebilanz unter angegebenen Bedingungen erklären.

goals.observablePerformanceEn: Show a shared intermediate or direct group transfer, add reactions and interpret dissipation using T and a complete system balance.

goals.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish separate ATP hydrolysis from mechanistic coupling and open cells from complete isothermal task models.
goals.atomicity: Coupling and entropy production are explanation of one complete thermodynamic process, not two unrelated routines. The native hold requires image repair, not a goal-body rewrite.
goals.caseFindings: Both whole bilingual cases inspected. A-P intermediate is actually consumed by the second step, so the -15 kJ/mol/50 J/(mol K) balance is genuine modeled coupling rather than arbitrary summation. Hexokinase direct ATP-to-glucose phosphate transfer is grounded in the named RCSB mechanism; synthetic +14/-31 gives -17 kJ/mol and 54.84 J/(mol K) only under full isothermal/isobaric/no-other-work assumptions. Open cell concentrations/matter/work flows and lack of personal laboratory evidence are explicit. No error requires changing these profiles.
goals.memoryReason: The competence requires mechanistic and system-balance explanation, with energy values supplied. Memorizing ATP numerical energies would be misleading and is unnecessary.

It adds unlike dimensions (J and J/K) without T and describes strict greater-than where a complete no-other-work balance uses the dissipation term T·Sgen. This directly undermines the dimensional and conditional distinction tested by the two correct cases. Correct this specific balance/qualification and rebind the actual image/native tuple. Mechanical enzyme imagery alone is an orientation metaphor and is not a separate unsupported stoichiometric fault.
